objective: Map where a new root directive for handoff-ready state and a handoff-summary CLI command would live in HolyAgent.
scope: Read-only, in /home/user/holyagent-0.3.2-integration (the 0.3.2 release head, same tree as release/0.3.2/integration).

Planned change (Intent intent-0mwaz75rz-i978): a root directive in every model family (claude-5.5, gpt-6, kimi-k3.1) that (1) pushes holyagent/state in the branch state mode after each Assignment close, each merge and before ending a turn; (2) keeps a status-and-open-items requirement on the Intent in use (merged PRs, open PRs and CI, next step, residuals, untested-live items), updated at each merge, new blocker and before the final report; (3) a holyagent CLI command that prints a self-contained handoff summary from state (open Intents with requirements, Assignments with state/objective/outcome, recorded branches and PRs, open items).

Map, with paths and line ranges: (a) the requirements tree for root rules (requirements/root/...), the requirement ids and how a requirement is written, the family translation files for claude-5.5, gpt-6 and kimi-k3.1 and the coverage table (coverage.ts or similar), and the repo's requirements skill (.claude/skills/requirements) steps; which existing root requirement files cover state push, the Intent, version control and the final report (the new directive should extend or sit next to these); (b) how the branch state mode commits and pushes today (runtime source for state commits, any existing push or 'pull before closing' logic, and the holyagent/state worktree setup); (c) the CLI command registry and the existing read-only commands that print state (status, reconcile, requirements, intent show, assignment reports), their source and tests, and the output format they use, so a handoff command can follow it; where the Assignment record's result and acceptance and the Intent's work branches and PRs are stored (vcs commit/pr record them on the Intent); (d) the docs that describe state, the CLI commands and the root's duties (docs/*.md) that the change would update; (e) any session-start hook text that restates root rules (the 'Rules most often missed' list) and where it is generated.

Report the concrete files to change for each part, and anything in the current design that conflicts with the plan (for example a rule that only the root writes state, or that state pushes ride work pushes).
constraints: Read only; make no edits and no git writes.
Report in under 600 words; put a longer file map in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-holyagent/43946df6-456d-58c6-bea3-7e958fcb9495/scratchpad/map033.md and give its path.

criteria.text: Each of parts a to e names the files and line ranges to change, with source evidence
